steps.label: 2108-master-qa-missing-omr-select-approved
command: (() => {const fs=document.getElementById('statusFields');if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089238'||!fs.disabled||fs.querySelector('[name=viewFlag]:checked').value!=='R')throw Error('Expected own untouched draft');document.querySelector('[data-status-edit]').click();const y=fs.querySelector('[name=viewFlag][value=Y]');if(fs.disabled||y.matches(':disabled'))throw Error('Approval transition unavailable');y.click();return {action:'Open actual status editing and select approved-use locally',selected:fs.querySelector('[name=viewFlag]:checked').value,locked:fs.disabled};})()

steps.label: 2109-master-qa-missing-omr-save-blocked
command: (() => {const fs=document.getElementById('statusFields'),b=document.querySelector('[data-status-save]'),preview=document.querySelector('.omr-preview-btn');if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089238'||fs.disabled||fs.querySelector('[name=viewFlag]:checked').value!=='Y'||b.type!=='button'||preview.getAttribute('data-saved-omr'))throw Error('Expected missing OMR local approval trial');const validation=OmrValidate.checkData('SBSANM',{omr:null,answer:null});if(!validation)throw Error('Expected actual validator rejection');b.click();return {action:'Actual Save control invoked; final confirmation not accepted',validation,alerts:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert]')].map(e=>e.innerText),modalIds:[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show')].map(e=>e.id)};})()

steps.label: 2110-master-qa-dirty-leave-open
command: (async()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089238'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Unexpected modal or route');const m=document.getElementById('statusLeaveModal');await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Dirty-leave modal did not finish showing')),5000);m.addEventListener('shown.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});document.querySelector('[data-list-link]').click();});return {id:m.id,text:m.innerText};})()

steps.label: 2112-master-qa-dirty-leave-cancel
command: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('#statusLeaveModal.show');if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089238'||!m||document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show').length!==1)throw Error('Expected single status-leave modal');await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Dirty-leave modal did not finish hiding')),5000);m.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve();},{once:true});m.querySelector('.modal-footer [data-bs-dismiss=modal]').click();});return {action:'Stay on item with local status edits retained'};})()
